change: Ignore terminal resize for a reaped process whose output descriptor is retained for draining or cleanup. The existing stable-ID process map remains in use.
checks: An exited entry keeps its original terminal size.
A live entry with the same modeled numeric PID receives its requested size.
The old and live terminals remain independent.
A missing ID changes neither terminal.
A non-TTY entry is not resized.
An entry without an output descriptor is not resized.

local_verification.test_binary: Actual asagiri-init unit-test executable; the two linux::agent::cleanup_tests tests ran inside an owned unprivileged native container.

before.selection: Original resize lookup extracted unchanged into the handler helper for the regression test.

local_verification.scope: The PTYs and ioctl results are real. Process-table PID reuse is modeled; no host PID churn or signals to unrelated processes occur.

remaining_issue_scope: The pre-cgroup.kill raw-PID cleanup fallback still needs a separate fix.
Full current-source hosted platform qualification and live restart/PID-churn stress are pending.
